title: Cream Tee & Dark Wide Jeans
prompt: An original young woman with long, soft brown waves stands full-length against a warm tan backdrop. She wears a white short-sleeve tee with a navy script graphic, a pearl chain necklace, and dark wide-leg jeans with patch pockets and frayed hems. She holds a black tote over one arm and wears black ankle boots. Her expression is calm and direct. Soft, even studio light. Palette of ivory, navy, and warm tan. Relaxed and polished, in the style of an autumn catalog.
workingNotes:
- The navy script and wide jeans are the defining pieces.
- Add 'full-length' to keep the boots in frame.
